messages:
maria: Heads-up: after the executive sync, priority shifted — SSO pilot must be in the MVP but per-tenant routing and routing analytics should move to v1. need a quick scope sync.

sam: Copy. Routing analytics is big. we can keep a minimal routing API for defaults, but no UI.

taylor: Agree with minimal API. Routing UI has UX + infra work (validation, policy editor). cutting it buys dev time.

priya: From security side, SSO + KMS + audit logs are non-negotiable for the pilot customers. anything that impacts key handling needs to stay.

jen: Ops note: removing routing UI reduces rollout complexity, but we still need a fallback if the default policies misroute traffic. planning a quick fallback toggle.

maria: Proposed MVP scope (sketch):
```
- Must have: SSO pilot flow, KMS integration, audit logging, default route matching (no custom rules)
- Nice to have (v1): per-tenant routing rules, routing UI, routing analytics dashboard
- Keep: observability hooks + small telemetry for routing requests
```

sam: timeline impact? current milestone 2026-06-10 is tight. with cuts, we can aim for an internal alpha mid-June and public pilot late June.

priya: realistic dates: internal alpha 2026-06-16, public pilot 2026-06-23. compliance window still needs a slot — booked review 2026-06-07.

jen: release-bot: updated canary schedule: public pilot 2026-06-23, 4-day canary, rollback on >4% error or latency >500ms P95.

release-bot: canary_window: 2026-06-23 -> 2026-06-27; rollback_conditions: ["error_rate>4%","p95_latency>500ms"];

maria: Risk list in brief:
- Customer expectations for per-tenant routing (mitigate: docs + pilot notes)
- Compliance gating on KMS (mitigate: prioritize KMS review, provide rotation proof)
- Telemetry blind spots (mitigate: add routing_request event + usage counter)

sam: Action items: @taylor remove routing UI from MVP branch, add feature flag; @priya confirm compliance slot and KMS checklist; @jen update release playbook & ops toggle; @maria draft customer-facing pilot notes.

taylor: started branch `mvp/sso-cut-routing-ui`, left a TODO for the client SDK change. skipping UI e2e test for MVP, adding note to reenable in v1.

priya: added KMS rotation proof item to security review agenda. also requested a faster path for signing the audit log retention policy.

jen: adding an emergency rollback runbook to playbook. will include commands, telemetry checks, and contact matrix.

maria: can we add lightweight telemetry: event `routing_request_click` + `routing_ui_access_attempt` to measure demand? we can rely on that to justify v1 prioritization.

sam: yes, and wire it to a dashboard with a simple count per customer. low lift.

priya: small ask: when cutting features, ensure release notes explicitly call out limitations and v1 timeline. ops needs that for SRE runbook.

maria: will draft release notes and a short FAQ. aiming to share with sales/solutions by EOD tomorrow.

jen: one more ops constraint: deploy freeze 2026-06-20 -> 2026-06-26 for the compliance window. exceptions via oncall with documented approval.

sam: sounds good. anything else?

maria: nothing else. thanks all ":thumbsup:" — i'll update milestone tracker and ping stakeholders.

release-bot: milestone_tracker: updated 2109999999 -> MVP scope changed: SSO prioritized, routing UI deferred to v1.
_meta: synthetic slack thread about scope negotiation, cutlist, and milestone shifts for an SSO MVP
